description: Publishes a posted sales invoice, credit note or quote behind a link the customer opens without an account and without a password: the token in the url is the whole secret. It returns that token once and stores only its hash, so give the url to the customer and say it cannot be read back. The page shows the document as it was sent and what is still owed on it today, so the link stays worth opening after a payment. A purchase document is refused — it is a third party’s own document — and so is a draft. A link is never edited: to change when it expires, withdraw it and make another.

document_id.description: The sales document to publish. A purchase document and a draft are refused.

expires_at.description: When the link stops answering, as a timestamp. Left out, it answers until it is withdrawn.

name: share_document
title: Publish a document behind a link
